result.summary: Found 2 issues: a loading spinner overlay sitting on top of the first restaurant image and a minor spacing/rendering problem in the rating text.

issues.description: A stray loading spinner overlay appears in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, partially obscuring the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading indicator once the image has loaded, or show it behind the image instead of on top of it.

issues.description: The rating text for Tokumaru Ramen Bar is truncated: the star icon and "4.8" are shown but the rating appears as "4.8 (500+)" with a visible gap/overlap before the count, making the text run together.
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing or formatting between the score and the review count so the rating reads cleanly as "4.8 (500+)".
